task.title: Make the pump safe for maintenance

prereq.p: Have the work order, model and serial number, isolation diagram, process-material assessment, and qualified personnel available.

step.cmd: Record the model, serial number, configuration, and work order.
Stop the pump by the site operating sequence. Wait until the shaft stops.
Isolate and lock out every electrical source. Have a qualified electrician verify absence of voltage.
Close the process isolation valves. Vent through the designated connection and verify zero gauge differential.
Check the surface temperature. Continue only when exposed parts are below 45 °C.
Attach the isolation record to the work order. Keep the keys under site control.

result.p: Isolation record complete; zero voltage and zero gauge differential recorded; shaft stationary.
